en.text: Opportunity Cost

zh.text: 機會成本

en.text: Tommy was asked to choose one birthday present from the following three thins: a model spaceship, a walkman and a jacket. He liked the model spaceship the most and the walkman second. What would be his opportunity cost if he chose the model spaceship?

zh.text: 湯美被要求從以下三件物品中選擇一份生日禮物：一個太空船模型、一部隨身聽和一件外套。他最喜歡太空船模型，其次是隨身聽。若他選擇了太空船模型，他的機會成本會是什麼？

en.text: a walkman

zh.text: 一部隨身聽

en.text: a walkman and a jacket

zh.text: 一部隨身聽和一件外套

en.text: the price of a model spaceship

zh.text: 太空船模型的價格

en.text: no opportunity cost since it was a present

zh.text: 沒有機會成本，因為這是一份禮物

en.text: HKCEE 1990 Paper 2 Q1

zh.text: 香港中學會考 1990 卷二 第 1 題

en.text: Susan is choosing between two jobs: being a teacher and being a singer. If she chooses to be a singer, her opportunity cost will include

zh.text: 蘇珊想在教書工作和歌唱事業兩者選擇其一。如果她選擇歌唱事業，她的機會成本會包括

en.text: the income from being a teacher.

zh.text: 作為教員的收入。

en.text: the income from being a singer.

zh.text: 作為歌手的收入。

en.text: the tuition fee she paid for her training as a teacher.

zh.text: 她已經支付的受訓做教員的學費。

en.text: the tuition fee she paid for her training as a singer.

zh.text: 她已經支付的受訓做歌手的學費。

en.text: HKCEE 1991 Paper 2 Q2

zh.text: 香港中學會考 1991 卷二 第 2 題

en.text: Which of the following are opportunity costs of attending school?

zh.text: 以下哪些項是上學讀書的機會成本？

en.text: (1) and (2) only
(1) and (3) only
(2) and (4) only
(3) and (4) only
school fees

zh.text: 學費

en.text: income forgone

zh.text: 所放棄的收入

en.text: poor examination results

zh.text: 差劣的考試成績

en.text: expenditure on dinners

zh.text: 晚餐的開支

en.text: HKCEE 1992 Paper 2 Q3

zh.text: 香港中學會考 1992 卷二 第 3 題

en.text: Mr Wong could spend two hours at a concert or tutoring a student at $60 per hour. He could use the time on painting instead and earn a total of $150. If the price of the concert ticket is $300, what is the opportunity cost of his choice of going to the concert?

zh.text: 黃先生可以花兩小時出席一音樂會；或替學生補習，收費每小時$60。他又可用這段時間來繪畫，賺取$150。若音樂會的票價為$300，他選擇出席該音樂會的機會成本是多少？

en.text: HKCEE 1993 Paper 2 Q2

zh.text: 香港中學會考 1993 卷二 第 2 題

en.text: Mr. Lee owns a photographic studio. Previously he received $30000 per month by letting it out. He now does not let the studio, but, instead he uses the premises for his own business. He also employs a model at $10000 per month.

zh.text: 李先生擁有一間攝影室。以往他出租攝影室時，每月可收到三萬元租金。現在，他不將攝影室出租，而用它來經營自己的生意，並且以月薪一萬元聘用一位模特兒。

en.text: What is Mr. Lee’s opportunity cost of using the studio by himself?

zh.text: 李先生自己使用這攝影室的機會成本是甚麼？

en.text: $10000 per month

zh.text: 每月一萬元

en.text: $20000 per month

zh.text: 每月二萬元

en.text: $30000 per month

zh.text: 每月三萬元

en.text: $40000 per month

zh.text: 每月四萬元

en.text: HKCEE 1994 Paper 2 Q3

zh.text: 香港中學會考 1994 卷二 第 3 題

en.text: Fanny can choose among three different jobs. Her choice of preference is as follows:

zh.text: 芬妮可在三份工作中選擇其一。她的選擇偏好如下：

en.text: First priority: 	being a teacher in School X

zh.text: 首選：		在 X 學校當教師

en.text: Second priority: 	being a secretary in Company Y

zh.text: 次選：		在 Y 公司當秘書

en.text: Third priority: 	being a sales representative in Firm Z

zh.text: 第三選擇：	在 Z 廠商當營業代表

en.text: Assuming her choice of preference remains unchanged, which of the following will increase Fanny’s opportunity cost of being a teacher in School X?

zh.text: 假設芬妮的選擇偏好次序不變，下列哪一種情況會增加她在 X 學校當教師的機會成本？

en.text: The students in School X are becoming more naughty.

zh.text: X 學校的學生變得更頑劣。

en.text: Company Y requires its secretaries to work longer hours.

zh.text: Y 公司要求它的秘書增加工作時間。

en.text: Company Y decides to increase the salaries of its secretaries.

zh.text: Y 公司決定增加它的秘書的薪金。

en.text: Firm Z decides to increase the bonuses for its sales representatives.

zh.text: Z 廠商決定增加它的營業代表的年終獎金。

en.text: HKCEE 1995 Paper 2 Q5

zh.text: 香港中學會考 1995 卷二 第 5 題

en.text: John lives in this own apartment which is worth is worth $1 million. He can sell the apartment and put the money in a bank at an interest rate of 5% per year. He can also rent out the apartment at $5000 a month. What is the opportunity cost to John if he decides to live in the apartment?

zh.text: 大強居住於自己擁有的住宅單位，該單位價值一百萬元。他可以出售該單位，將所獲金錢存於銀行，以年息率 5%來收息。他亦可以將該單位出租，每月收取租金 $5,000。對大強來說，他決定在該單位自住的機會成本是什麼？

en.text: $1 million

zh.text: 一百萬元。

en.text: $50000 a year
$5000 a month
There is no opportunity cost because he lives in his own apartment.

zh.text: 沒有機會成本，因為他用來自住。

en.text: HKCEE 1996 Paper 2 Q1

zh.text: 香港中學會考 1996 卷二 第 1 題

en.text: Max Department Store has launched a promotion campaign. For every purchase of $1 000, customers are given a coupon to exchange for the following gifts:

zh.text: 麥氏百貨公司展開推廣活動：凡顧客每購物滿$1,000，便可獲得一張換物券，換取下列禮物：

en.text: Number of Coupons

zh.text: 換物券（張數）

en.text: Gifts

zh.text: 禮物

en.text: 1 camera

zh.text: 1 部攝影機

en.text: 1 TV set

zh.text: 1 部電視機

en.text: 1 air ticket

zh.text: 1 張機票

en.text: John has accumulated 30 coupons. What is the opportunity cost to John if he uses them to exchange for one air ticket?

zh.text: 大雄累積了 30 張換物券，若他拿來換取一張機票，他的機會成本是什麼？

en.text: a TV set

zh.text: 一部電視機

en.text: a camera and a TV set

zh.text: 一部攝影機和一部電視機

en.text: a camera, a TV set and $30 000

zh.text: 一部攝影機、一部電視機和$30,000

en.text: HKCEE 1997 Paper 2 Q2

zh.text: 香港中學會考 1997 卷二 第 2 題

en.text: Later, John finds that he has to queue up to exchange his coupons for gifts. The queue shows that

zh.text: 後來，大雄發現用換物券來換取禮物必須排隊輪候。排隊輪候這件事顯示

en.text: these gifts are truly free of charge.

zh.text: 這些禮物是真正免費的。

en.text: there is a shortage of gifts for all the customers.

zh.text: 禮物數量短缺，不足以分派給全部顧客。

en.text: the promotion campaign is successful and there is an increase in the demand for the company’s products.

zh.text: 該推廣活動是成功的，同時該公司的產品需求亦有所增加。

en.text: customers has an extra cost to obtain the gifts.

zh.text: 顧客要獲得禮物須付出額外的代價。

en.text: HKCEE 1997 Paper 2 Q3

zh.text: 香港中學會考 1997 卷二 第 3 題

en.text: Before the sale of a big residential estate, many elderly people queued up outside the site office for potential buyers. This implies that

zh.text: 在某大型屋邨出售前，地盤辦事處門外有很多老人替準買家排隊輪候。這意味：

en.text: the value of the flats to these elderly people was higher than to young people.

zh.text: 以這些老人和年輕人相比，該批樓宇對前者來說價值較高。

en.text: the price of the flats was above the equilibrium level because there was a shortage.

zh.text: 由於有短缺出現，該批樓宇的價格高於均衡水平。

en.text: the opportunity cost of the queuing time of these elderly people was lower than that of the potential buyers.

zh.text: 這些老人排隊所用時間的機會成本，較準買家的為低。

en.text: the opportunity cost of the queuing time of these elderly people was zero because they did not have a job.

zh.text: 這些老人排隊所用時間的機會成本為零，因為他們沒有工作。

en.text: HKCEE 1997 Paper 2 Q49

zh.text: 香港中學會考 1997 卷二 第 49 題

en.text: Chan and Wong take a journey to City X separately. They can go there either by plane or by train. The plane takes 2 hours while the train takes 10 hours. The air ticket costs $1 000 while the train fare is $200. During the journey to City X, the foregone earning of Chan is $200 per hour and that of Wong is $80 per hour.

zh.text: 陳先生和黃先生分別前往 X 城，他們可以乘飛機或火車前往。飛機需時 2 小時而火車需時 10 小時。飛機票價 $1 000 而火車票價 $200。在前往 X 城的旅程中，陳先生放棄的收入是每小時 $200 而黃先生放棄的收入是每小時 $80。

en.text: For the journey to City X, Chan would take the __________ and Wong would take the __________.

zh.text: 若要前往 X 城，陳先生會乘搭 ______ 而黃先生會乘搭 ______。

en.text: train ... train

zh.text: 火車 ... 火車

en.text: train ... plane

zh.text: 火車 ... 飛機

en.text: plane ... train

zh.text: 飛機 ... 火車

en.text: plane ... plane

zh.text: 飛機 ... 飛機

en.text: HKCEE 2000 Paper 2 Q2

zh.text: 香港中學會考 2000 卷二 第 2 題

en.text: Which of the following is
NOT
an opportunity cost of constructing Disneyland in Hong Kong?

zh.text: 下列哪一項並非在香港興建迪士尼樂園的機會成本？

en.text: the alternative use of the site

zh.text: 園址的其他用途。

en.text: the amount of capital invested

zh.text: 投資的金額。

en.text: the pollution created by the construction work

zh.text: 建築工程造成的污染。

en.text: the entrance fee of Disneyland

zh.text: 迪士尼樂園的入場費。

en.text: HKCEE 2000 Paper 2 Q53

zh.text: 香港中學會考 2000 卷二 第 53 題

en.text: When convicted for the same crime, a wealthy person is often punished less severely than a poor person by the court because the wealthy person can hire better and more lawyers. However, the total cost of the crime to a wealthy person is higher because

zh.text: 當因同一罪行而被定罪時，富人往往被法庭判處較輕的刑罰，因為富人能聘請更好且更多的律師。然而，犯罪對富人而言的總成本較高，因為

en.text: his earning is higher.

zh.text: 他的收入較高。

en.text: his social status is worth more.

zh.text: 他的社會地位更有價值。

en.text: he will have a larger decline in future income.

zh.text: 他未來的收入將有較大幅度的減少。

en.text: All of the above.

zh.text: 以上皆是。

en.text: HKALE 2000 Paper 1 Q25

zh.text: 香港高級程度會考 2000 卷一 第 25 題

en.text: Which of the following will change the cost to an individual of attending a concert?

zh.text: 下列哪一項會改變某甲入場觀看演唱會的機會成本？

en.text: He is an hour late for the concert due to traffic congestion.

zh.text: 因爲交通擠塞，他遲了一小時才入場觀看演唱會。

en.text: His view is blocked by the audience in front of him.

zh.text: 他的視線被前面的觀眾遮擋著。

en.text: The singer performs badly.

zh.text: 歌手的表演差勁。

en.text: The concert overruns by an hour.

zh.text: 這場演唱會超時一小時。

en.text: HKCEE 2001 Paper 2 Q1

zh.text: 香港中學會考 2001 卷二 第 1 題

en.text: Mr Lee lives in his own house. He bears an opportunity cost from living in that house because

zh.text: 李先生在自置物業裏居住。他在該居所內居住是有機會成本的，因爲

en.text: (1) only

zh.text: 只有 (1)

en.text: (1) and (2) only
(1) and (3) only
(2) and (3) only
he could earn rental income from letting the house to others.

zh.text: 他可將該居所出租，以賺取租金收入。

en.text: he has to pay property tax to the government.

zh.text: 他要繳付物業稅給政府。

en.text: he has paid a sum of money to buy the house.

zh.text: 他支付了一筆金錢，以購買該居所。

en.text: HKCEE 2002 Paper 2 Q3

zh.text: 香港中學會考 2002 卷二 第 3 題

en.text: Which of the following would affect the cost of constructing the West Rail?

zh.text: 下列哪一項會影響建造西鐵的代價？

en.text: an increase in the damage to the natural environment along the railway caused by the construction

zh.text: 建築工程對沿鐵路線自然環境造成的損害增加。

en.text: an increase in the wages of the maintenance staff for the operation of the train service

zh.text: 該鐵路維修員工的工資增加。

en.text: a decrease in the profit from providing the train service

zh.text: 該項火車服務的利潤減少。

en.text: a decrease in the revenue of the bus company operating a bus service along the railway

zh.text: 提供鐵路沿線巴士服務的巴士公司收益減少。

en.text: HKCEE 2002 Paper 2 Q4

zh.text: 香港中學會考 2002 卷二 第 4 題

en.text: Peter is an F.5 graduate who could not get a study place in F.6. Which of the following may lower the cost of repeating F.5 for Peter?

zh.text: 喜福是中五畢業生，但找不到中六學位就讀。下列哪一項可能減低他重讀中五的代價？

en.text: The tuition fee for study in F.5 increases.

zh.text: 入讀中五學費增加。

en.text: The tuition fee for study in F.6 decreases.

zh.text: 入讀中六學費下降。

en.text: The wage rate for F.5 graduates decreases.

zh.text: 中五畢業生的工資率下降。

en.text: Peter’s new F.5 English teacher teaches badly.

zh.text: 喜福的新的中五英文科老師教得差勁。

en.text: HKCEE 2003 Paper 2 Q2

zh.text: 香港中學會考 2003 卷二 第 2 題

en.text: Medical doctors seldom change their occupation. Which of the following can explain this phenomenon?

zh.text: 醫生少有轉業。下列哪一項可解釋此現象？

en.text: They have spent much time and effort in getting their professional licence.

zh.text: 他們已花費大量時間及努力以獲取執業牌照。

en.text: They have incurred high costs in accumulating the skills and knowledge required for the profession.

zh.text: 他們已付出高昂代價以累積專業知識和技能。

en.text: For medical doctors, changing occupation has a high cost.

zh.text: 他們轉業須付出高昂代價。

en.text: Being medical doctors has a high cost.

zh.text: 他們當醫生須付出高昂代價。

en.text: HKCEE 2003 Paper 2 Q3

zh.text: 香港中學會考 2003 卷二 第 3 題

en.text: Which of the following statements about the concept of opportunity cost is correct?

zh.text: 下列哪一項關於機會成本概念的陳述是正確的？

en.text: Opportunity cost still exists even when there are no choices.

zh.text: 即使沒有選擇，還是有機會成本。

en.text: Opportunity cost does not exist in a planned economy.

zh.text: 在計劃經濟中並沒有機會成本。

en.text: When the value of an option decreases, the opportunity cost of choosing that option does not change.

zh.text: 當某選擇的價值下降時，揀選該選擇的機會成本不會改變。

en.text: When the value of the highest-valued option increases, the opportunity cost of choosing that option will decrease.

zh.text: 當「價值最高的選擇」的價值增加時，揀選該項選擇的機會成本會下降。

en.text: HKCEE 2004 Paper 2 Q2

zh.text: 香港中學會考 2004 卷二 第 2 題

en.text: David is choosing between two ways of spending his summer vacation: to take a summer job or to join an exchange programme to the United Kingdom. Which of the following will increase his opportunity cost of taking the summer job?

zh.text: 大衛可選擇以下兩種方式之一度過他的暑假：做暑期工或參加一項前往英國的交流計劃。下列哪一項會增加他做暑期工的機會成本？

en.text: The fee for the exchange programme increases.

zh.text: 該交流計劃的費用增加了。

en.text: The summer job pays a higher salary.

zh.text: 該暑期工的工資提高了。

en.text: A valuable course is added to the exchange programme.

zh.text: 該交流計劃多提供一項有價值的課程。

en.text: Less training for the summer job is provided.

zh.text: 從該暑期工中獲得的培訓減少了。

en.text: HKCEE 2005 Paper 2 Q3

zh.text: 香港中學會考 2005 卷二 第 3 題

en.text: A resident of Mainland China is choosing between a tour to Hong Kong and a tour to Macau organized by a travel agent. His opportunity cost of choosing to visit Hong Kong will increase if

zh.text: 一位中國內地居民考慮在下列二者選擇其一：參加某旅行社主辦的旅行團往香港旅行或往澳門旅行。在下列哪一種情況下，他選擇往訪香港的機會成本會增加？

en.text: the food provided during his trip in Hong Kong is poorer than expected.

zh.text: 在香港的旅程中，食物的質素較預期為差。

en.text: he is abandoned on the streets in Hong Kong by the tour guide.

zh.text: 給導遊遺棄在香港的街頭。

en.text: newly developed tourist attractions in Macau make it more enjoyable to visit Macau.

zh.text: 澳門新發展的景點使澳門的旅客更享受其旅程。

en.text: the rental of hotel accommodation in Macau increases.

zh.text: 澳門的酒店房租上升。

en.text: HKCEE 2007 Paper 2 Q2

zh.text: 香港中學會考 2007 卷二 第 2 題

en.text: Which of the following could raise the cost of drug abuse?

zh.text: 下列哪項會增加濫用藥物的代價？

en.text: The price of drugs increases.

zh.text: 藥物價格上升。

en.text: The government imposes heavier punishments on drug abuse.

zh.text: 政府加重對濫用藥物的懲罰。

en.text: Drug abuse causes greater damage to one’s health.

zh.text: 濫用藥物對人的健康產生更大的傷害。

en.text: All of the above are correct.

zh.text: 以上全部正確。

en.text: HKCEE 2008 Paper 2 Q2

zh.text: 香港中學會考 2008 卷二 第 2 題

en.text: Which of the following situations will increase the opportunity cost to Form 7 graduates of receiving a university education?

zh.text: 下列哪種情況會增加中七畢業生接受大學教育的機會成本？

en.text: (1) and (2) only
(1) and (3) only
(2) and (3) only
The university undergraduate programme increases from 3 years to 4 years.

zh.text: 大學學士課程由三年制轉為四年制。

en.text: The wage rate of Form 7 graduates increases.

zh.text: 中七畢業生的工資率上升。

en.text: The academic performance of university graduates generally declines.

zh.text: 一般大學畢業生的學術水平下降。

en.text: HKCEE 2009 Paper 2 Q2

zh.text: 香港中學會考 2009 卷二 第 2 題

en.text: Julie is choosing between Hong Kong and the US to complete her university education. Her opportunity cost of studying in the US will increase when

zh.text: 朱莉選擇在香港或美國完成她的大學教育。在下列哪種情況下，她在美國求學的機會成本會上升？

en.text: the number of scholarships offered by the universities in the US increases.

zh.text: 美國的大學增加獎學金的名額。

en.text: the tuition fee of the universities in Hong Kong increases.

zh.text: 香港的大學增加學費。

en.text: the university graduates of Hong Kong become less competitive in the job market than those of the US.

zh.text: 與美國的大學畢業生相比，香港的大學畢業生在就業市場的競爭力下降。

en.text: the standard of professional training programs offered by the universities in Hong Kong improves.

zh.text: 香港的大學提供的專業訓練課程的水平有所提高。

en.text: HKCEE 2010 Paper 2 Q2

zh.text: 香港中學會考 2010 卷二 第 2 題

en.text: A piece of land can be used for the construction of a high speed railway, a highway, a tunnel or a cultural hub. Suppose the money value of the expected return generated by each project is $800 000, $750 000, $650 000 and $550 000 respectively.

zh.text: 一塊土地可用來建造高速鐵路、高速公路、隧道或文化區綜合發展項目。假設以上各項可帶來的預期回報的金錢價值分別為 $800 000、$750 000、$650 000 及 $550 000。

en.text: The opportunity cost of using this piece of land for the construction of a highway is ________ and the opportunity cost of using this piece of land for the construction of a tunnel is ________.

zh.text: 使用該塊土地來建造高速公路的機會成本是 ________；而使用該塊土地來建造隧道的機會成本是 ________。

en.text: HKCEE 2011 Paper 2 Q2

zh.text: 香港中學會考 2011 卷二 第 2 題

en.text: Mary is choosing between two ways of spending her Christmas vacation: to work for her uncle and earn $3 000 or to join a cultural tour to Beijing.

zh.text: 瑪莉正從下列兩種方式中選擇一個來度過她的聖誕假期：替叔叔工作以賺取三千元；參加一個前往北京的文化之旅。

en.text: Which of the following will lower Mary’s opportunity cost of working for her uncle?

zh.text: 下列哪項會減低瑪莉替叔叔工作的機會成本？

en.text: Mary’s uncle reduces her wage to $2 000.

zh.text: 瑪莉的叔叔將她的人工減至兩千元。

en.text: The fee for the cultural tour decreases.

zh.text: 參加文化之旅的費用下降。

en.text: An attractive section of the cultural tour is canceled.

zh.text: 文化之旅其中一個精彩項目被取消。

en.text: Mary’s uncle agrees to employ her best friend to work with her.

zh.text: 瑪莉的叔叔同意聘請她最要好的朋友與她一起工作。

en.text: HKDSE Sample Paper Paper 1 Q2

zh.text: 香港中學文憑考試 樣本試卷 卷一 第 2 題

en.text: Mr. Chan spent $5 000 on buying a new mobile phone which can be sold for $7 000 in the second-hand market. Mr. Chan’s cost of keeping the mobile phone is __________.

zh.text: 陳先生花了 $5000 購買一部新手提電話，該電話可在二手市場以 $7000 售出。陳先生保留該手提電話的成本是 ________。

en.text: HKDSE Practice Paper Paper 1 Q2

zh.text: 香港中學文憑考試 練習卷 卷一 第 2 題

en.text: Mr Kwok plans to purchase a new racing car from a German automobile manufacturer and drive the car in Hong Kong. In which of the following situations will the cost of purchasing the racing car increase?

zh.text: 郭先生計劃從德國的汽車製造商購買一部新跑車，並在香港駕駛。下列哪種情況會令購買該部跑車的成本上升？

en.text: The first registration fee increases.

zh.text: 首次登記費上升。

en.text: The price of gasoline increases.

zh.text: 汽油價格上升。

en.text: The Euro depreciates against the Hong Kong dollar.

zh.text: 歐元兌港元貶值。

en.text: The racing car performs poorly.

zh.text: 該跑車性能欠佳。

en.text: HKDSE 2012 Paper 1 Q2

zh.text: 香港中學文憑考試 2012 卷一 第 2 題

en.text: Jeremy is going to watch a tennis match in which Li Na (李娜), a Grand Slam (大滿貫) winner, will play. Which of the following will increase the cost to Jeremy of watching the tennis match?

zh.text: 書豪將觀看大滿貫得主李娜參與的一場網球比賽。下列哪項會令書豪觀看該場網球比賽的成本上升？

en.text: He is 30 minutes late for the match due to traffic congestion.

zh.text: 由於交通擠塞，他遲到了 30 分鐘。

en.text: His view is blocked by the spectators in front of him.

zh.text: 他的視線被前面的觀眾阻擋。

en.text: Due to a rainstorm, the match is extended by an hour.

zh.text: 由於暴雨關係，比賽時間延長了一小時。

en.text: Li Na is injured and does not show up for the match.

zh.text: 李娜受傷，沒有出場比賽。

en.text: HKDSE 2013 Paper 1 Q2

zh.text: 香港中學文憑考試 2013 卷一 第 2 題

en.text: A famous football team, Manchester United, visited Hong Kong for a friendly match. The day before the match, the team found the pitch in the Hong Kong Stadium had been damaged by prolonged rain and it considered cancelling the match. The opportunity cost for Manchester United to continue playing in such a poor pitch would __________ because __________.

zh.text: 著名足球隊曼聯到訪香港進行一場友誼賽。比賽的前一天，該隊發現香港大球場的草地被連場大雨破壞，該隊考慮取消比賽。曼聯繼續在該惡劣草地進行比賽的機會成本會 ________，因爲 ________。

en.text: increase ... there was a higher chance for the players to get injured

zh.text: 上升 …… 球員受傷的機會增加了

en.text: increase ... the team was likely to have poor performance

zh.text: 上升 …… 球隊很有可能表現差劣

en.text: remain unchanged ... the expense on the visit to Hong Kong had already been paid

zh.text: 維持不變 …… 球隊已經支付了到訪香港的開支

en.text: remain unchanged ... the players spent the same amount of time in Hong Kong

zh.text: 維持不變 …… 球員在香港所花的時間是相同的

en.text: HKDSE 2014 Paper 1 Q1

zh.text: 香港中學文憑考試 2014 卷一 第 1 題

en.text: David can choose to take the MTR or a bus to Yuen Long. Suppose the required travel time and the fares of both options are the same in a normal situation. Which of the following will result in an increase in the opportunity cost of travelling to Yuen Long by MTR?

zh.text: 大衛可選擇乘搭港鐵列車或巴士往元朗。假設上述兩種選擇所需的交通時間和車費在正常情況下均相同。下列哪項會引致乘搭港鐵列車往元朗的機會成本上升？

en.text: The air-conditioner on the bus is out of order.

zh.text: 巴士的空調設備發生故障。

en.text: The traffic jam makes the bus trip 15 minutes longer.

zh.text: 交通阻塞令巴士車程延長了 15 分鐘。

en.text: A signalling problem causes the travel time of the MTR to increase by 15 minutes.

zh.text: 訊號問題令港鐵列車車程增加了 15 分鐘。

en.text: David feels annoyed about the news broadcast in the MTR train.

zh.text: 大衛對港鐵列車車廂內的新聞廣播感到煩擾。

en.text: HKDSE 2015 Paper 1 Q2

zh.text: 香港中學文憑考試 2015 卷一 第 2 題

en.text: Mr Ng, a Hong Kong citizen, is going to travel to Tokyo for leisure. Which of the following will decrease his cost of having the trip?

zh.text: 一名香港市民吳先生準備前往東京旅遊。下列哪項會令他去這次旅遊的成本下降？

en.text: A typhoon is approaching Tokyo right before his trip.

zh.text: 在他出發前，有一颱風剛剛移近東京。

en.text: His boss is going to treat all the staff to a free buffet during his leave.

zh.text: 在他放假期間，他的老闆將會請全體同事享用自助餐。

en.text: The scenery in Tokyo is better than he expected.

zh.text: 東京的風景比他想像中更優美。

en.text: Japanese Yen depreciates against other currencies.

zh.text: 日圓兌其他貨幣貶值。

en.text: HKDSE 2016 Paper 1 Q3

zh.text: 香港中學文憑考試 2016 卷一 第 3 題

en.text: Which of the following would be the loss(es) of delaying the completion of a new railway to an economy?

zh.text: 對某經濟而言，下列哪 (幾) 項屬延遲建成一條新鐵路的損失？

en.text: (1) only

zh.text: 只有 (1)

en.text: (2) only

zh.text: 只有 (2)

en.text: (3) only

zh.text: 只有 (3)

en.text: the travel time of passengers that would have been saved by the new railway during the period of delay

zh.text: 該新鐵路原本在延遲期間能為乘客節省的交通時間

en.text: the damage to the corporate image of the railway constructor for the delay

zh.text: 因新鐵路工程延遲對承建商公司形象所造成的損害

en.text: the nuisance to the shops and residents nearby during the period of delay

zh.text: 對新鐵路附近的商店及居民在延遲期間所造成的滋擾

en.text: HKDSE 2017 Paper 1 Q4

zh.text: 香港中學文憑考試 2017 卷一 第 4 題

en.text: John, a Secondary 6 graduate, is considering studying a programme either in Hong Kong or the Mainland. Which of the following situations would lower his opportunity cost of studying the programme in Hong Kong?

zh.text: 約翰是一名中六畢業生，他正考慮留港或到內地修讀一個課程。下列哪些情況會降低他留港修讀該課程的機會成本？

en.text: (1) and (2) only
(1) and (3) only
(2) and (3) only
His tuition fee of the first year will be waived if he studies the programme in Hong Kong.

zh.text: 若他留港修讀該課程，他首年的學費會獲豁免。

en.text: The graduates of the Mainland programme have better job prospects.

zh.text: 該內地課程的畢業生就業前景較佳。

en.text: The qualification of the Mainland programme may not be recognised in Hong Kong.

zh.text: 該內地課程所頒授的學術資格在港可能不獲承認。

en.text: HKDSE 2018 Paper 1 Q3

zh.text: 香港中學文憑考試 2018 卷一 第 3 題

en.text: Mr Lo spent $60000 on buying a second hand car three years ago. Suppose he can resell the car at $2000. Alternatively, he needs to spend $5000 on repairing the car before he can continue to use it. What is his cost of continuing to use the car?

zh.text: 盧先生三年前用 $60000 買入一輛二手車。假設他能以 $2000 將該車轉售。或者，他需要花 $5000 維修該車，才可以繼續使用它。他繼續使用該車的成本是多少？

en.text: HKDSE 2019 Paper 1 Q3

zh.text: 香港中學文憑考試 2019 卷一 第 3 題

en.text: After graduating from secondary school, Paul considers whether to become a full-time Key Opinion Leader (KOL) in social media channels or to become an e-sports player.

zh.text: 中學畢業後，保羅考慮成為全職的社交媒體頻道關鍵意見領袖 KOL（俗稱網紅）或成為電競選手。

en.text: Which of the following will lower Paul’s cost of being a full-time KOL after his graduation?

zh.text: 下列哪些會減低保羅畢業後成為全職 KOL 的成本？

en.text: (1) and (2) only
(1) and (3) only
(2) and (3) only
Paul receives sponsored video equipment for KOL.

zh.text: 保羅獲得錄製 KOL影片器材的贊助。

en.text: The e-sports team offers a lower basic salary to Paul.

zh.text: 電競隊給予保羅較低的基本薪金。

en.text: The risk of social media channels being attacked by hackers increases.

zh.text: 社交媒體頻道被駭客攻擊的風險增加。

en.text: HKDSE 2021 Paper 1 Q3

zh.text: 香港中學文憑考試 2021 卷一 第 3 題

en.text: Because of COVID-19, normal schooling was disrupted. Most schools used video communication software, such as Zoom and Google Meet, to conduct online lessons. Suppose the school campus was re-opened and face-to-face lessons were allowed.

zh.text: 由於新冠肺炎，學校的日常教學受到干擾，大部分學校使用視訊軟件（例如 Zoom 和 Google Meet）進行網上授課。假設校園重新開放，並准許面對面授課。

en.text: Which of the following would be the
LEAST
important factor for teachers to choose between online lessons and face-to-face lessons?

zh.text: 下列哪項是教師選擇網上授課還是面對面授課時最不重要的因素？

en.text: The risk of contracting COVID-19 for teachers is lower when they conduct online lessons.

zh.text: 網上授課會減低教師感染新冠肺炎的風險。

en.text: Teachers have no idea what their students are doing during online lessons because students may turn off their cameras.

zh.text: 教師不知道網上授課時學生正在做什麼，因為學生可能關掉鏡頭。

en.text: Teachers have already spent a lot of time learning how to use the video communication software to conduct online lessons.

zh.text: 教師已經花費很多時間學習使用視訊軟件進行網上授課。

en.text: The eyesight of teachers may be worsened by the intensive use of the video communication software in conducting online lessons.

zh.text: 頻密使用視訊軟件進行網上授課可導致教師的視力受損。

en.text: HKDSE 2021 Paper 1 Q4

zh.text: 香港中學文憑考試 2021 卷一 第 4 題

en.text: Tommy is planning for his future after his S.6 graduation. He has several options and his order of preference is as follows.

zh.text: 湯美中六畢業，正計劃將來。他有數個選項，其優先次序如下：

en.text: First option: 		Being a barista in a café

zh.text: 第一選項： 在咖啡店當一名咖啡師

en.text: Second option: 		Being a trainee in digital marketing

zh.text: 第二選項： 當一名數碼市場推廣業的實習生

en.text: Third option: 		Being a junior fireman

zh.text: 第三選項： 當一名初級消防員

en.text: Which of the following factors would
LEAST
likely affect the cost-benefit analysis for Tommy’s career choice?

zh.text: 在湯美的就業選擇中，下列哪項因素最不可能影響他的成本效益分析？

en.text: Coffee culture becomes more popular.

zh.text: 咖啡文化愈趨普及。

en.text: More companies expand their digital marketing departments.

zh.text: 更多公司擴張其數碼市場推廣部。

en.text: The remuneration of junior firemen worsens.

zh.text: 初級消防員的薪金下降。

en.text: Safety measures of fire-fighting are improved drastically.

zh.text: 救火的安全措施大幅改善。

en.text: HKDSE 2022 Paper 1 Q3

zh.text: 香港中學文憑考試 2022 卷一 第 3 題

en.text: Mr Cheung bought restaurant premises 2 years ago for $5 000 000 and sells ‘two-dish-rice’ meal boxes at the premises. Recently, his monthly profit has decreased from $30000 to $10000 due to the opening of new restaurants nearby. A businessman offers to rent Mr Cheung’s restaurant premises for a monthly rental of $15000.

zh.text: 張先生兩年前以 $5000000 購入一個餐廳鋪位，並於該鋪位出售「兩餸飯」。由於他的店鋪附近最近開了一些新餐廳，導致他每月的利潤由 $30000 下降至 $10000。一名商人提出以每月 $15000 租金租用張先生的鋪位。

en.text: Which of the following would be included in Mr Cheung’s opportunity cost of continuing to operate his ‘two-dish-rice’ business at the premises?

zh.text: 下列哪項屬張先生繼續於該鋪位經營「兩餸飯」生意的機會成本？

en.text: the $5 000 000 purchase price of the restaurant premises

zh.text: 該鋪位的購入價 $5000000

en.text: the $10000 monthly profit

zh.text: 每月 $10000 的利潤

en.text: the $15000 monthly rental

zh.text: 每月 $15000 的租金

en.text: the $20000 drop in monthly profit

zh.text: 每月減少了的 $20000 利潤

en.text: HKDSE 2023 Paper 1 Q1

zh.text: 香港中學文憑考試 2023 卷一 第 1 題

en.text: Jacky, a Secondary 6 student in Hong Kong, is going to travel to Korea for his graduation trip. Which of the following will decrease his cost of having the graduation trip to Korea?

zh.text: 志傑是一名香港中六學生，他打算到韓國畢業旅行。以下哪項會令他到韓國畢業旅行的成本下降？

en.text: Hong Kong dollar appreciates against South Korean Won.

zh.text: 港元兌韓圜升值。

en.text: The return flight from Korea to Hong Kong is delayed.

zh.text: 由韓國飛往香港的回程航班延誤。

en.text: The number of confirmed cases of COVID-19 in Korea has increased drastically.

zh.text: 韓國的新冠肺炎確診宗數大幅上升。

en.text: The services of the hotel in Korea are better than his expectation.

zh.text: 韓國的酒店服務比他預期的好。

en.text: HKDSE 2023 Paper 1 Q2

zh.text: 香港中學文憑考試 2023 卷一 第 2 題

en.text: Mr Chan lives in his own apartment which is worth $8 000 000. He can sell the apartment and deposit the $8 000 000 in a bank at an interest rate of 5% per year. He can also rent out the apartment at $25 000 a month.

zh.text: 陳先生居住在自己擁有的住宅單位，該單位價值 $8 000 000。他可以出售該單位，並將所得的 $8 000 000 存入銀行，以年利率 5% 來收取利息。他亦可以將該單位出租，每月收取租金 $25 000。

en.text: Based on the above information, which of the following statements are correct?

zh.text: 根據上述資料，下列哪些陳述是正確的？

en.text: (1) and (2) only
(1) and (3) only
(2) and (3) only
When the market value of his apartment increases, the opportunity cost for Mr Chan to live in his own apartment will not be affected.

zh.text: 當陳先生的住宅單位的市值上升時，他居住在自己擁有的住宅單位的機會成本不會受影響。

en.text: When the deposit interest rate increases, the opportunity cost for Mr Chan to live in his own apartment will increase.

zh.text: 當存款利率上升時，陳先生居住在自己擁有的住宅單位的機會成本會上升。

en.text: When the rental value of his apartment increases, the opportunity cost for Mr Chan to live in his own apartment may increase.

zh.text: 當陳先生的住宅單位的租值上升時，他居住在自己擁有的住宅單位的機會成本可能上升。

en.text: HKDSE 2024 Paper 1 Q1

zh.text: 香港中學文憑考試 2024 卷一 第 1 題

en.text: Susan planned to watch a concert and bought a ticket of the concert for $1500. Soon after Susan bought the ticket, a company offered to pay her $3000 for a part-time job. However, the work hours of the part-time job clashed with the time of the concert. At the same time, as all tickets were sold out, her friend offered to buy her concert ticket for $1800.

zh.text: 蘇珊計劃觀看一場演唱會，並以 $1500 購買了一張該場演唱會的門票。蘇珊剛購買門票後，一間公司給予她一份薪酬 $3000 的兼職工作。然而，該兼職的工作時間與該場演唱會的時間相撞。與此同時，由於所有門票經已售罄，她的朋友提出以 $1800 購買她那張演唱會門票。

en.text: Based on the above information, at the time when Susan was deciding whether to sell the concert ticket to her friend, her opportunity cost of choosing to watch the concert would be _____.

zh.text: 根據以上資料，在蘇珊決定是否將演唱會門票出售予她的朋友時，她選擇觀看該場演唱會的機會成本是 _____。

en.text: HKDSE 2025 Paper 1 Q1

zh.text: 香港中學文憑考試 2025 卷一 第 1 題

en.text: Private dentists in Shenzhen generally charge lower fees than those in Hong Kong. Despite the longer travel time to Shenzhen, many Hong Kong residents still choose to visit private dentists in Shenzhen.

zh.text: 深圳的私家牙醫收費一般較香港的私家牙醫低。儘管前往深圳需時較長，許多香港居民仍選擇前往深圳私家牙醫求診。

en.text: Which of the following statements about the above phenomenon are correct?

zh.text: 下列哪些有關上述現象的陳述是正確的？

en.text: (1) and (2) only
(1) and (3) only
(2) and (3) only
The cost of Hong Kong residents to visit private dentists in Shenzhen would increase if more time is required to cross the border.

zh.text: 當過境所需時間增加，香港居民前往深圳私家牙醫求診的成本會上升。

en.text: The service quality of private dentists in both places would not affect the cost of Hong Kong residents to visit private dentists in Shenzhen.

zh.text: 兩地私家牙醫的服務質素不會影響香港居民前往深圳私家牙醫求診的成本。

en.text: Those Hong Kong residents with higher time costs tend to visit local private dentists in Hong Kong instead of private dentists in Shenzhen.

zh.text: 那些時間成本較高的香港居民傾向在本地私家牙醫求診，而非前往深圳私家牙醫求診。

en.text: HKDSE 2026 Paper 1 Q2

zh.text: 香港中學文憑考試 2026 卷一 第 2 題

en.text: Answer

zh.text: 參閱以下資料，回答

en.text: by referring to the following information:
